# origincloud_billing_project_billing_info (Resource)

Which billing account pays for a project.

Every project has its project billing info, which exists with it: creating this resource updates the existing project billing info with the settings configured, and the rest keep their values. Destroying it unsets the settings Terraform set, leaving the others as they are; to stop managing it without unsetting them, remove it from the state instead (a `removed` block with `lifecycle { destroy = false }`, or `terraform state rm`). Manage each project billing info with one resource only: two would undo each other's settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `billing_account` (String) The billing account that pays for the project's usage, one of its organization's.
- `project` (String) The project the project billing info is in. Changing it replaces the project billing info.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project billing info's resource name, the same as `name`.
- `name` (String) The billing info's resource name, `projects/{project}/billingInfo`.
